title: A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Global Study of Sapablursen in Polycythemia Vera
official: A Phase 3 Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Global Study of Sapablursen in Polycythemia Vera
summary: Main objective: To compare the clinical efficacy of sapablursen vs placebo in participants with PV through 32 weeks
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1 Written informed consent by the participant prior to Screening, participant who understands the study procedures and is able to adhere to study requirements
2. 2 Meets revised 2022 World Health Organisation (WHO) and 2022 International Consensus Classification (ICC) criteria for the diagnosis of PV
3. 3 Participants must be phlebotomy-dependent
4. 4 Hct less than (<) 45% at study start
5. 5 Adequate organ function and electrolytes
6. 6 Participants receiving Cytoreduction therapy (CRT) must be on a stable regimen at study start.
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1 Prior treatment of PV with transmembrane serine protease 6 (TMPRSS6) inhibitors, including sapablursen or hepcidin mimetics.
2. 2 Clinically significant thrombosis (eg, myocardial infarction, stroke, deep vein thrombosis or splenic vein thrombosis) within 1 month prior to randomization.
3. 3 Participants who require phlebotomy at Hct levels less than (<) 45%
4. 4 Meet the criteria for post-PV myelofibrosis as defined by the International Working Group-Myeloproliferative Neoplasms Research and Treatment
5. 5 Any serious or unstable medical condition or uncontrolled psychiatric condition as judged by the Investigator that would interfere with their ability to comply with study requirements.
6. 6 Female participants who are pregnant, planning to become pregnant during the study, or breastfeeding.
